description: This file defines various reusable Flutter widgets, including CardShell for card layout, _LoadingBar for loading placeholders, and EmptyState for displaying empty or placeholder content.

classes.name: CardShell
classes.description: A customizable, clickable card container with an optional icon, title, and action button, styled with Ocean theme feel.

classes.name: _LoadingBar
classes.description: A private widget representing a horizontal loading placeholder bar.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget to display an empty state message with optional icon, either in compact or full mode.

methods.name: loadingOrChild
methods.description: Static method that shows a shimmer-like loading placeholder or the provided child widget based on isLoading.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method in each widget to return the widget tree.
